title: Cross-laboratory auditory brainstem threshold inference from complete waveform stacks
disposition_reason: Threshold-loss arithmetic and complete prediction ledgers are delivered, but the evaluator deliberately emits aggregate scores only for generated engineering controls. Native annotation semantics, complete waveform census and source-only comparators must be authenticated before an actual transfer score can be admitted.

scientific_target.question: Can complete averaged ABR voltage-versus-time stacks predict expert-annotated hearing-response thresholds for the 104-mouse held laboratory beyond sound-level and frequency priors?
scientific_target.known_answer: Expert threshold in dB SPL for each animal×stimulus series, or an explicitly documented censored interval; it is an annotation of averaged physiology.
scientific_target.answer_origin: thresholds.csv in Zenodo version 15619100, after authentic native label/sentinel/censoring verification; wave 1 annotations are separate diagnostic targets.
scientific_target.case_unit: One complete target animal×stimulus-frequency/click stack over all recorded levels.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Animal; ear/session/frequency/level/trace are nested. The one held laboratory is not a replicated laboratory sample.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Agreement with expert waveform interpretation across this acquisition-laboratory transfer, conditional on source-only training and verified voltage/time units.
exclusions: Human diagnosis or behavioral hearing thresholds.
Published mixed-lab ABRA test performance as a score on the proposed 104-mouse held-lab target.

inputs: Every measured averaged voltage trace in each complete level stack, physical time grid, stimulus level in dB SPL and tone frequency or explicit click category.
Source-supported 244-sample/10-ms common representation only after native timing and units are verified; preserve normalization range/offset.
Strict matched direct/program/tool design supplies the same four source calibration stacks; full-support fitted methods are a separate information condition.
forbidden_inputs: Held-animal thresholds, peak annotations, rater decisions, annotation-derived filenames, genotype/identity lookup proxies.
ABRA pretrained weights unless training provenance excludes every target mouse; published mixed-lab weights may contain target exposure.
observation_contract.case_identity: Scorer accepts unique opaque case_id tied to an animal roster and stimulus descriptor. Authentic case IDs and duplicate-ear/session joins are not delivered; do not manufacture 104×9 observed cases.
observation_contract.split: Prospective: all 104 Marcotti animals held out; complete Manor/Liberman data provide support with animal-grouped validation. No native split manifest is delivered.
observation_contract.coverage: Required target 104 animals,54/50 genetic-background roster, all recorded levels and eight tones plus click. Native case count remains unresolved; source metadata is not waveform coverage.

primary.name: Animal-macro absolute threshold error in dB SPL
primary.aggregation: Mean distance to exact/censored annotation interval over each animal’s complete stimulus cases, then equal animal mean.
primary.rationale: Preserves animal replication and documented censoring instead of scoring each correlated level trace as an independent threshold.

secondary: Within 5/10 dB fractions and signed error on exact labels.
Full prediction coverage, abstention rate, interval width and coverage stratified by declared nominal coverage.
Waveform-minus-level/frequency-only paired error; background/frequency strata remain descriptive.

comparators.name: Frequency/level-only prior
comparators.inputs: Identical permitted source support and physical stimulus metadata; no voltage.
comparators.procedure: Freeze source-only conditional median threshold before target access; fit on only four calibration stacks in matched mode, complete support in separately labeled full-support mode.

comparators.name: Source-only waveform threshold model
comparators.inputs: Same waveform representation and declared training-information arm.
comparators.procedure: Implement and qualify a waveform classifier/threshold aggregator fitted without target mice; audit historical ABRA aggregation separately. Existing scorer accepts comparison predictions but supplies no competent fit.

nuisance_controls: Treat click source code 100 as a category, never a 100 Hz tone.
Verify sample duration; app truncation to 244 native samples cannot establish 10 ms.
Audit early stimulus-artifact and phase/time perturbation controls, with unchanged level/frequency metadata.
Reconcile paired ears and repeated recordings; preserve weak/no-response series.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap over complete target animals, conditional on fixed source fits and one held laboratory; no independent-laboratory population interval.
evaluation.failure_policy: Missing/duplicate/nonfinite/invalid required predictions withhold aggregate score and retain complete ledger. Finite abstained predictions remain in primary loss. Current code also withholds aggregate for unverified authentic references.

implementation.scorer_target: Interval-distance threshold error, exact-label diagnostics, complete animal roster and prediction failure ledger. This is a real measurement-annotation endpoint, not reproduction of a paper table.
implementation.delivered_scope: Standalone standard-library numerical evaluator and threshold-rule audit. No native waveform loading, participant packets, prediction method or protected runner.
missing: Authenticate full target/support animal and stack census, time and voltage units, annotation censoring and equality conventions.
Deliver matched complete observation packets and source-only competent waveform/stimulus comparators.
Add reviewed authentic-score admission only after those source facts and protected custody are established.
implementation.execution_evidence: Existing generated engineering tests exercise arithmetic and complete-support refusal. Source inspection confirms unverified prepared 104-animal references remain score-blocked; no authentic transfer run is claimed.

direct_observation.representation: Complete numeric or fixed waveform stack plus four labeled source stacks is scientifically meaningful.
direct_observation.boundary: No tools, source lookup or target labels; all levels and samples must fit the frozen context.
missing: Authentic serializer, complete packet capacity and transport not delivered.

typed_viewer.representation: A typed waveform-stack viewer could expose time/level panels without raw export.
typed_viewer.boundary: Actions must retain full stack access and hide annotations; no viewer currently exists for this registration.
missing: Typed action protocol and observation-only renderer.

tool_assisted.representation: Per-case numerical investigation of the same complete stack and identical calibration support.
tool_assisted.boundary: No target feedback; models fitted on extra support form a separately named information condition.
missing: Candidate investigation interface, fixed tools and isolated episode.

frozen_program.representation: Freeze waveform predictor and fitting recipe before held-lab cases.
frozen_program.boundary: Identical four-stack evidence in matched mode; full-support source-only programme reported separately.
missing: Only scoring exists; no waveform predictor/executor or qualified authentic input route.

evidence.supports: Preserved source-backed registration, prospective scientific design and original exposure limitations; current implementation changes are described separately.

validate_reference permits generated controls or unverified prepared references; evaluate withholds authentic aggregate scores. _metrics implements interval-distance threshold error and animal macro aggregation.
Source package contains no data, waveform predictor, author weights or authentic-score admission.

evidence.locator: ABRA paper, cohort tables and waveform methods, as retained in the original registration
evidence.supports: Averaged ABR waveforms and expert threshold annotations; mixed-laboratory published results are not a held-Marcotti-laboratory result.
104 target mice, two genetic backgrounds, tone/click series and threshold annotations.
Complete named support release for source-laboratory training.

Current source-level storage-layout qualification: preserve all 426 raw legacy values and the paper Table S1 claim, but withhold both continuous 17 ms timing and a physiological 213+213 interpretation until a release-applicable writer/export specification reconciles the sources. The corrected parser emits sample-index axes with null physical periods and explicitly unqualified header-period metadata. Existing sealed preparations and their historical validation remain unchanged. This review does not qualify authentic inputs, model performance or a change of cohort or annotation criteria.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: The inspected source carries construction and generated software-control evidence. No neural programme pilot among the four historical EEG/sleep attempts is attributed to this registration, and no model or human outcome is added here.
excluded_claims: Human diagnosis or behavioral hearing thresholds.
Published mixed-lab ABRA test performance as a score on the proposed 104-mouse held-lab target.
Generated evaluator scores as authentic ABR transfer performance.
